4: O’er the Ilsen-stone. I peeped at the owl in her nest alone: How she stared and glared!
11: Betake thee to Hell! Why so fast and so fell?
18: She has scored and has flayed me: See the wounds she has made me!
25: The way is wide, the way is long: See, what a wild and crazy throng! The broom it scratches, the fork it thrusts, The child is stifled, the mother bursts. WIZARDS (semichorus)
31: As doth the snail in shell, we crawl: Before us go the women all. When towards the Devil’s House we tread, Woman’s a thousand steps ahead.
42: We do not measure with such care: Woman in thousand steps is theft. But howsoe’er she hasten may, Man in one leap has cleared the way.
51: Come on, come on, from Rocky Lake!
59: Aloft we’d fain ourselves betake. We’ve washed, and are bright as ever you will, Yet we’re eternally sterile still.
